description: This file declares the interface for MediaKeys and its factory class within the Rialto media client component. It defines classes, methods, and external dependencies related to media key management, including creation, session handling, and DRM operations.

classes.name: MediaKeysFactory
classes.description: Factory class for creating IMediaKeys instances, implementing the IMediaKeysFactory interface.

classes.name: MediaKeys
classes.description: Implementation of IMediaKeys, managing media key sessions and DRM operations within the Rialto client.

methods.name: createMediaKeys
methods.description: Creates a new IMediaKeys instance for a specified key system.

methods.name: MediaKeys
methods.description: Constructor for MediaKeys, initializing with key system and IPC factory.

methods.name: ~MediaKeys
methods.description: Destructor for MediaKeys.

methods.name: selectKeyId
methods.description: Selects a key ID for a given session.

methods.name: containsKey
methods.description: Checks if a key ID exists in a session.

methods.name: createKeySession
methods.description: Creates a new key session with specified type and client.

methods.name: generateRequest
methods.description: Generates a license request for a session.

methods.name: loadSession
methods.description: Loads an existing session.

methods.name: updateSession
methods.description: Updates a session with response data.

methods.name: setDrmHeader
methods.description: Sets DRM header data for a session.

methods.name: closeKeySession
methods.description: Closes a key session.

methods.name: removeKeySession
methods.description: Removes a key session.

methods.name: deleteDrmStore
methods.description: Deletes the DRM store.

methods.name: deleteKeyStore
methods.description: Deletes the key store.

methods.name: getDrmStoreHash
methods.description: Retrieves the hash of the DRM store.

methods.name: getKeyStoreHash
methods.description: Retrieves the hash of the key store.

methods.name: getLdlSessionsLimit
methods.description: Gets the limit for LDL sessions.

methods.name: getLastDrmError
methods.description: Retrieves the last DRM error code for a session.

methods.name: getDrmTime
methods.description: Gets the current DRM time.

methods.name: getCdmKeySessionId
methods.description: Retrieves the CDM key session ID.
